description: Colorado business entities (Colorado Department of State, via the Colorado Information Marketplace) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/co-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Colorado Department of State (via the Colorado Information Marketplace, data.colorado.gov)
sources.license: Public domain: the dataset's portal metadata states license 'Public Domain' (licenseId PUBLIC_DOMAIN). The portal's Terms of Service add no restriction on copying; they disclaim warranties and require applications using the data to show the State's disclaimer
sources.redistribution: Permitted (public domain); attribution: Colorado Department of State (CDOS), with the State of Colorado disclaimer from data.colorado.gov/terms shown where the data is used
sources.notes: Dataset 4ykn-tg5h 'Business Entities in Colorado': entity id, name, principal and mailing address, status, jurisdiction of formation, entity type, registered agent, formation date; 3,132,613 rows at review, updated daily after midnight. robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; /browse?...&q= search pages are disallowed, so the dataset page is used. The portal platform's own terms (socrata.com) still need a human read (same note as tx-comptroller-franchise).
